verdict.rationale: Wave documents bank auto-import with auto-merge and categorization (implying some duplicate/match handling), but there is no evidence of a dedicated reconciliation view that explicitly surfaces matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions for accountant review, nor of bank-to-ledger balance reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: explicit unmatched-transaction review UI, duplicate-transaction flagging documentation, and a formal reconciliation/statement-balance-match report.
